market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $80 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front month ~$103-107; touching $80 LOW in May requires ~22-25% decline in one month. Possible only on rapid Iran de-escalation or demand shock; base rate over a month for that magnitude is modest.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace of any Iran-US diplomatic breakthrough.
